scripts.docker:up: nub --cwd apps/api exec varlock run --inject vars -- node ../../scripts/docker.mjs up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 120
scripts.docker:down: nub --cwd apps/api exec varlock run --inject vars -- node ../../scripts/docker.mjs down
scripts.docker:build: nub --cwd apps/api exec varlock run --inject vars -- node ../../scripts/docker.mjs build
scripts.docker:ps: nub --cwd apps/api exec varlock run --inject vars -- node ../../scripts/docker.mjs ps
scripts.docker:logs: nub --cwd apps/api exec varlock run --inject vars -- node ../../scripts/docker.mjs logs --tail=100
scripts.test: nub --cwd packages/db run test && node --test scripts/docker.test.mjs
